meta.title: Fix Ollama model detection to ignore `:latest` tag when checking if model exists
meta.body_summary: Fix Ollama model detection to avoid unnecessary pulls when model specified without tag already exists as `:latest` on the server.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot PR fixing Ollama model tag detection; maintainer fixed tests and merge conflicts then closed PR without merge; no performance benchmarks.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1,976,568 changed lines across 196 files, the change scale is huge due to a broad merge of origin/dev; the core fix (~160 lines) is small. The PR was closed without merge, likely because the large noise from the merge obscured the fix and maintainer decided not to proceed.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer pelikhan requested to fix tests and to merge origin/dev and resolve conflicts. Copilot addressed both; PR was closed shortly after final commit.
review_details.performance_claim: Eliminate unnecessary Ollama model pulls when model specified without tag already exists as `:latest`.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer closed PR without merge after addressing initial requests; no CHANGES_REQUESTED or explicit rejection reason.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after performance data; only narrative claim that unnecessary pulls are eliminated.

core_change_summary.description: Added normalizeOllamaModelName() and areOllamaModelsEquivalent() in packages/core/src/ollama.ts and used them in nodehost.ts (originally packages/cli/src/nodehost.ts, later moved to packages/runtime/src/nodehost.ts after merge) to treat 'model' and 'model:latest' as equivalent.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Merge commit brought in large documentation and workflow changes unrelated to the fix.
